name: Spoiler Guard Lite
overview: Blurs episode thumbnails and strips spoiler metadata for unwatched items. Exempts Trickplay scrubbing.
description: Lightweight server-side spoiler prevention for Jellyfin 12.2+ with Moonfin Trickplay timeline scrubbing support.

versions.changelog: Initial release of Spoiler Guard Lite.
